text:
The user's prompt sets up a specific role-play scenario: the AI is to act as a relationship coach who will be provided with details about a conflict to offer specific suggestions. The user then provides the first request: "I require assistance in resolving conflicts between my spouse and me."

Assistant A provides generic, boilerplate relationship advice. While the advice is sound, it ignores the premise established in the first paragraph of the prompt—that the coach will be provided with details to offer tailored strategies. By jumping straight to general advice, Assistant A bypasses the diagnostic phase of coaching.

Assistant B correctly identifies that it lacks the necessary context to provide the "tailored advice" and "strategies to enhance understanding" requested in the persona description. By asking for the specific details of the conflict, Assistant B follows the logical flow of the established role-play and prepares to give a high-quality, relevant response once the data is provided.

[[B]]
